text.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似 \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-10ES+C,&\dot C&=10ES-2C,\\\dot E&=-10ES+2C,&\dot P&=C.\end{aligned};\quad E+C=E_0,\quad S+C+P=1,\quad K_m=\frac{k_{-1}+k_2}{k_1}=0.2;\quad \theta=E_0t,\quad \varepsilon=\frac{E_0}{K_m+S_0}\in\left\{\frac1{120},\frac1{600}\right\};\quad \frac{dS_{\rm MM}}{d\theta}=-\frac{S_{\rm MM}}{0.2+S_{\rm MM}},\quad S_{\rm MM}+0.2\log S_{\rm MM}=1-\theta 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
text.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-10ES+C,&\dot C&=10ES-2C,\\\dot E&=-10ES+2C,&\dot P&=C.\end{aligned};\quad E+C=E_0,\quad S+C+P=1,\quad K_m=\frac{k_{-1}+k_2}{k_1}=0.2;\quad \theta=E_0t,\quad \varepsilon=\frac{E_0}{K_m+S_0}\in\left\{\frac1{120},\frac1{600}\right\};\quad \frac{dS_{\rm MM}}{d\theta}=-\frac{S_{\rm MM}}{0.2+S_{\rm MM}},\quad S_{\rm MM}+0.2\log S_{\rm MM}=1-\theta Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.
